about: S-workout - the drawn data of the two fixture frames and the undrawn states of the player (PLAN 4.1 rule 7). Generated by fixtures.mjs beside this file - edit that, not this. Every fixture is a list of edits over the recording of the same endpoint (R26). Account M = user@ (replay only, never written).

workout-1.why: The freeze (a Thursday) holds the seed's freestyle session with English snapshots, 4 exercises and three other exercises half done; the frame draws the Friday plan day: five exercises in Hungarian (the fifth, Arcig húzás, is exercise 267 of the recorded library), only the first started, and last session's reps 8 / 9 / 7 / 7. Set 3 is the active one in both. Proposed to INT as scripts/fixtures/workout-1.json (request R-S-workout-04).

workout-2.why: One second after checking set 3 with 82,5 x 6: the POST is answered with an e1RM record, the refetch after it holds set 3 recorded, and the pinned clock is advanced 1 s so the toast (4 s), the record caption (1.4 s) and the rest clock (2:59 of 3:00) are on screen together. The entry's own advance of 20 s would end the toast and the caption and drain the clock to 2:39 (prep section 5). Proposed to INT as scripts/fixtures/workout-2.json (R-S-workout-04).

workout-finish.title: Edzéslejátszó - the Befejezés link in the header line (D3)
workout-finish.why: workout-1's drawn session (the same edits) with the back of the figure, as the frame draws it; the link only opens the sheet

workout-finish-confirm.title: Edzéslejátszó - the finish sheet: Befejezés / Félbehagyás / Mégse (D3)
workout-finish-confirm.why: the sheet opened from the header link over the drawn session; nothing is written (the choice is not made). Summary = the session's recorded / open sets: 2 and 15 on the drawn data

workout-finish-failed.title: Edzéslejátszó - the finish was refused (500): the sheet stays, danger dot + Újra
workout-finish-failed.why: a failed end must not look like one that worked: the sheet stays open with the error dot and Újra (repeats the same choice); the session stays live

workout-finish-done.title: Edzéslejátszó - Befejezés landed: the app is on Home
workout-finish-done.why: POST /workouts/:id/finish answers 200 (the outcome kept to a status, R26); the player leaves for Home (replace) and the session / today queries are invalidated (the refetched session is null)

workout-abandon-done.title: Edzéslejátszó - Félbehagyás landed: the app is on Home
workout-abandon-done.why: POST /workouts/:id/abandon answers 200; same landing as the finish

workout-live.title: Edzéslejátszó - the recording as it is (seed freestyle session, English snapshots)
workout-live.why: what user@ really shows on the freeze day, with no edit: the code against the recorded API

workout-media.title: Edzéslejátszó - hero stand-in (Videó pressed)
workout-media.why: the hero toggle swaps the figure for the media stand-in; there is no media asset, so the figure box stays empty and the side switch and legend go with the figure

workout-error.title: Edzéslejátszó - the session read failed
workout-error.why: a failed GET /workouts/current is not 'no session': F16's error line with Újra (never the redirect)

workout-freestyle-empty.title: Edzéslejátszó - a session with no exercises (API-only freestyle)
workout-freestyle-empty.why: the same grid with nothing in it: freestyle title, counter 1 / 0, no figure, empty list and switcher

workout-failed-other.title: Edzéslejátszó - a check the server refused (500)
workout-failed-other.why: the failed row: a danger notice over the row with Újra; nothing is recorded

workout-failed-conflict.title: Edzéslejátszó - a check refused as a conflict (409)
workout-failed-conflict.why: a 409 is not retryable: the row offers Visszavonás (void) instead of Újra

workout-offline-inflight.title: Edzéslejátszó - a check made with no network (the offline line, the check in flight)
workout-offline-inflight.why: the network is cut and the active set is checked: the offline line drops in, the column shrinks under it (the law holds), the pill shows its three dots. In the capture an offline request HANGS instead of failing, so the outbox answer and the row notice Nincs kapcsolat + Újra cannot be reached here (structure); the notice itself is the same NoticeLine workout-failed-other captures

workout-law.title: Edzéslejátszó - the player law probe: the active check inside the viewport above the bar
workout-law.why: run at 402 x 874 and 360 x 640 (--width / --height): the active check stays inside; at 360 x 640 the Q7 default takes the figure, the side switch and the legend away, so this state asserts the check, not Elöl

workout-law-rest.title: Edzéslejátszó - the player law probe while resting
workout-law-rest.why: the rest band takes 49 pt more than the switcher: the next active check must still be inside the viewport

workout-law-rest-offline.title: Edzéslejátszó - the player law probe while resting with the offline line
workout-law-rest-offline.why: the worst case of the law: the offline line drops in during a rest

workout-withdrawn.title: Edzéslejátszó - a withdrawn (voided) set
workout-withdrawn.why: a voided set is neither done nor pending: struck through, locked, no check control, the word Visszavonva

workout-interval-idle.title: Edzéslejátszó - an interval block, timer shown, not started
workout-interval-idle.why: no seed has an interval block: the first exercise becomes a circuit of 40 s rounds with 20 s rest; the Időzítő toggle swaps the figure for the stage
